main_body: autumn tree with orange-red foliage canopy and vertical brown trunk
top_band: upper lit crown of the canopy (bright orange/amber rows 1-11) sitting above shaded lower foliage clusters and trunk
evidence: The tree canopy has a rounded volumetric 3/4 form with a top-lit upper crown (rows 1-11) and overlapping lower foliage lobes that overhang and cast a shadow (row 28) onto the vertical trunk (rows 29-44).

style.evidence: While the canopy has 6 orange-red shading steps and speckled dithered texture with a dark-red-brown outline, the trunk (rows 28-44) is drawn as a rigid, straight-sided pillar with a solid near-black outline, a flat 1px horizontal base, and a repetitive mechanical diagonal stripe pattern, completely lacking the organic flared roots, natural bark texture, and integrated branch structure of the Beodeul reference trees.
